LESSON: DATA SAFETY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.2: Data Safety

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Data Safety
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is data protected in an electronic device?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify threats to data in an electronic device
2. describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify threats to data in an electronic device

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify threats to data in an electronic device.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify threats to data in an electronic device” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify threats to data in an electronic device” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify threats to data in an electronic device" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device

Teach
• Today’s focus: describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device” using a school example.
• Model B for “describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify threats to data in an electronic device
• Model 2: describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify threats to data in an electronic device
2. Practise: describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Data Safety.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is data protected in an electronic device?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify threats to data in an electronic device
• describe ways of protecting data in an electronic device

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
